depiction.primary_object: six-toothed mechanical gear or cogwheel with inner ring
modifiers: two four-pointed sparkle stars at top right
depiction.composition: single gear at bottom left with two sparkles at top right

readings.meaning: AI settings or AI model configuration

ambiguity: Could be confused with a plain settings gear, or at very small sizes with a Coronavirus/microbe glyph or a sun with stars.

modifier_semantics.meaning: AI, smart automation, magic/auto-configure, or new/clean

reasoning: A gear combined with four-pointed AI/magic sparkles is the standard modern pictogram for automation, smart routines, auto-configuration, and AI settings. It fits tasks about building workflows (Zapier, Shortcuts, HomeKit) or tuning AI tools, while remaining distinct from a plain settings cog.
